title: Enhancing Cross-Grade Generalization in Banana Variety Classification via Hybrid CNN-Transformers and Knowledge Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29008v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In recent years, automated fruit classification systems have become a more critical component in precision agriculture for efficient yield estimation, quality control, and supply chain optimization. However, they still face significant challenges under varying quality, fruit maturity, illumination, texture degradation, morphological attributes, domain shift, and post-harvest handling conditions. In this study, we address the challenging issue of cross-grade banana variety classification. This is a real-world setting where models that have been trained on specific quality grades must generalize to unseen grades to handle significant domain shift. Under a rigorous Leave-One-Grade-Out evaluation protocol, we present a thorough comparative analysis of CNNs, ViTs, and dual-stream hybrid architectures using a large-scale dataset of 31,678 banana images with three varieties and three quality grades. translated_title: 通过混合CNN-Transformer与知识自蒸馏增强香蕉品种分类的跨等级泛化能力
translated_abstract: 近年来，自动化水果分类系统已成为精准农业中日益关键的组成部分，可用于高效的产量估计、质量控制和供应链优化。然而，在质量变化、水果成熟度、光照条件、纹理退化、形态特征、领域偏移以及采后处理条件等因素影响下，这些系统仍面临重大挑战。在本研究中，我们解决了具有挑战性的香蕉品种跨等级分类问题。这是一个真实世界的场景，即在特定质量等级上训练的模型必须泛化到未见过的等级，以应对显著的领域偏移。在严格的“留一等级”评估协议下，我们基于包含三个品种和三个质量等级、共31,678张香蕉图像的大规模数据集，对CNN、ViT和双流混合架构进行了全面的比较分析。具体而言，为解决……的缺点（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究提出将混合CNN-Transformer架构与知识自蒸馏相结合，在“留一等级”评估协议下显著提升了香蕉品种分类模型对未见质量等级的跨等级泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture combined with knowledge self-distillation to enhance cross-grade generalization in banana variety classification under a rigorous Leave-One-Grade-Out evaluation protocol.
